newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate finishes firmer.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate finishes firmer.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed firmer on Friday after the central bank issued negotiable certificates of deposit for a second day to mop up liquidity.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.689 percent against Thursday's 4.491 close, with 30-day commercial paper stable at 4.60-4.65. Dealers expected the interbank rate to gradually rise to above 5.00 percent level next week.
The bond market took a wait-and-see stance before Saturday's central bank board meeting. The 10-year 86/2 government bond, which was auctioned Friday afternoon, had a yield at 5.705.
